AI.name: ResourceLoad
AI.note: Load resource in Memory and Returns address of file., Params: resource file like 'sounds.res','AI/303.qvm'

AI.name: ResourceUnload
AI.note: Unload resource loaded in memory, Params: resource file like 'sounds.qvm','AI/303.qvm'

AI.name: IsResourceLoaded
AI.note: Check where resource is in loaded in memory, Params: resource 'sounds.qvm','AI/303.qvm' and address of res file

AI.name: EnemyDetectorOverlay
AI.signature: uint32_t EnemyDetectorOverlay(int contextBase, int targetAddr, float sortingDistance, int configFlag, int *screenPosition, int eventParam, int extraParam1, int extraParam2)
AI.note: Shows red box on enemy when using binoculars. Params: contextBase=AI/render base (e.g. 0x01A3F4C0), targetAddr=target address (e.g. 0x00472C50), sortingDistance=float (e.g. 12.5), configFlag=overlay type (e.g. 1), screenPosition=out vec2 ptr, eventParam/extraParam1/extraParam2=optional (0).

AI.name: AIAction_Patrol
AI.signature: void AIAction_Patrol(int path_id, int start_node, int end_node);
AI.note: Assigns patrol route path and node loop boundaries for AI guard entity.

AI.name: AIAction_FallFlat
AI.note: Forces AI guard to fall flat on ground for specified duration.

AI.name: AIAction_WalkToNode
AI.note: Orders guard AI to walk to a designated path node.

AI.name: AIAction_RunToNode
AI.note: Orders guard AI to run to a designated path node.

AI.name: AIAction_PlayAnimation
AI.note: Plays skeletal animation sequence on AI guard model.

AI.name: AIAction_PlaySound
AI.signature: void AIAction_PlaySound(int sound_id, float volume, float pitch);
AI.note: Triggers voice/sound playback on AI guard entity.

AI.name: AIAction_MoveToEvent
AI.note: Orders AI to move toward detected sound or vision event location.

AI.name: AIAction_LookAtEvent
AI.note: Rotates AI head/eyes to look at event origin.

AI.name: AIAction_Stunned
AI.note: Puts AI into stunned reaction state (e.g. Flashbang).

AI.name: AIAction_Idle
AI.note: Puts AI guard in passive idle stance for specified time.

AI.name: AIFunction_SetAlarmTriggerID
AI.note: Links guard AI to alarm button task ID.

AI.name: AIFunction_SetAlarmControlID
AI.note: Links guard AI to alarm control panel task ID.

AI.name: AIFunction_SetGunnerID
AI.note: Links AI guard to stationary gun/turret task ID.

AI.name: AIFunction_SendResponse
AI.note: Sends AI response signal to event pump.

AI.name: HumanAIConfigItem
AI.note: Human AI config item registration.

AI.name: HumanAIConfig
AI.note: Human AI config task type.

AI.name: HumanAI
